summary: Iteration 6 e2e testing of Ações Soltas (/acoes) and Sub-jogos (/sub-jogos) + regression on existing modules. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py — 22/22 passed (loose-action CRUD, profile isolation, subgame PUT/GET with metric_result cross-checked on a dedicated deterministic goalkeeper, auth guards, regression endpoints). Frontend: full Playwright flows passed — loose action create/list/persist/delete, validation toasts, 5 sub-game cards, topic dialog (name/avaliação/fonte/valor, value select disabled until fonte chosen), metric shown (13 ações / 85% sucesso / 11/13 verdes), edit, delete, persistence after reload, all 8 nav tabs work. UI integration verified in Base de Dados: after 1 loose action Cintra went Total de ações 31→32 while Nº de relatórios (4) and Média ações/jogo (7.8) stayed unchanged and no 'Ações soltas' row appears in the reports list. All test data cleaned (db.reports loose=2 removed, subgame_evals=3 removed; reports back to 18).

minor.issue: Counts loose-action documents as relatórios: returns reports=20 while the sum of per-GK report_count is 18 (2 loose docs). Dados Gerais therefore inflates the number of games, contradicting the 'ações soltas não contam como jogo' rule. Fix: filter {'loose': {'$ne': True}} for the report count (actions may still be counted).
No brute-force lockout: 7 consecutive wrong passwords all returned 401 and the valid login still succeeded immediately (playbook expects lockout after 5 failures).
SubgamesIn.subgames is a raw dict; the declared SubgameTopic model is never used, so arbitrary/unvalidated topic payloads are stored (no length/shape validation on names, fields or values).

issues: Brand block wraps: 'LEÕES DE PORTO SALVO' breaks over two lines and the subtitle 'ANÁLISE DE GUARDA-REDES' is clipped by the fixed h-16 header (text cut mid-line).
With 8 nav items the labels wrap onto two lines ('Base de Dados', 'Sub-jogos', 'Dados Gerais'), making the top bar look cramped; consider shorter labels, smaller px gap, or a compact/overflow menu.
Sonner toasts render centred over the nav bar and visually cover nav items while visible.
Topic delete (sj-del) has no confirmation dialog, unlike Ações Soltas which uses window.confirm — inconsistent and risky for destructive action.
Ações Soltas delete uses native window.confirm instead of the shadcn AlertDialog used elsewhere (BaseDados).

action_items: Exclude loose reports from the report count in GET /api/insights/general (Dados Gerais shows 20 instead of 18).
Add login brute-force lockout (5 failed attempts) per auth playbook.
Optional: validate subgames payload with the existing SubgameTopic model.
Fix header layout/overflow (brand subtitle clipped, nav labels wrapping) and align delete confirmations (sub-jogos topic delete has none).
critical_code_review_comments: insights_general() reads db.reports.find() without the loose filter used everywhere else — single source of truth for 'game reports' should be a shared query helper to avoid this class of drift.
/api/export also exports loose docs; verify the import path preserves the loose flag, otherwise re-imported data will be counted as games.
server.py is 1226 lines (PDF generation + auth + CRUD + insights) — split into routers/modules (>700 line guideline).
add_loose_action uses upsert+$push correctly, but there is no cap/pagination on the loose actions array; a single document could grow unbounded over a season.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (acoes, sub-jogos, nav, profile integration)

rca_of_the_issue: Dados Gerais discrepancy: compute_profile, list_goalkeepers and gk_reports were updated to filter {'loose': {'$ne': True}}, but insights_general (line ~638) still uses db.reports.find() unfiltered, so the synthetic 'Ações soltas' report document is counted as a relatório. Reproduce: POST /api/goalkeepers/{id}/loose-actions then GET /api/insights/general -> reports increases by 1 while the sum of per-GK report_count stays the same.
